translations.3796628820122597519: HIPMaster is a personal, free project, with no advertising and nothing to sell, created by Obemm, its owner. It is played by invitation. For any question, or to exercise your rights: go through the person who invited you, or open a request on {$START_LINK}the project repository{$CLOSE_LINK} (requests there are public: never write your recovery code in one).
translations.3844967692316863290: the game server: Google Cloud (Cloud Run), in Frankfurt;
translations.6961781261220304356: What the game keeps, and why
translations.1905111275821609588: Nothing more than what is needed to play and to protect the game:
translations.2734266827128641435: {$START_TAG_STRONG}your account{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}: the username you chose, its creation date, the invitation that allowed it, and a fingerprint of your recovery code (never the code itself). No name, no email, no password;
translations.1287882126395004769: {$START_TAG_STRONG}your sessions{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}: one per signed-in device, with a fingerprint of its token (never the token) and its opening date;
translations.5550143331267776770: {$START_TAG_STRONG}technical logs{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}: for each request, the time, the address requested, the response and the IP address it came from, to fix outages and detect abuse. The same IP address is also used, for one hour at most, to limit the number of requests.
translations.1238432290428691220: This data is used solely to run the game you asked for, and to keep it secure. It is never sold, shared or used to profile you.
translations.5970566513799599543: The game keeps only one thing there: your session token, which saves you from entering your code on every visit. It is strictly necessary for the service, so no consent banner is required. The game uses no advertising cookies, no trackers and no audience measurement tools.
translations.4555961231960277750: The game never deletes your account, your collection or your results on its own: only technical data expires, and it is erased every night.
translations.6934507302516536249: You can at any time access your data, have it corrected, object to its use or have it deleted. The simplest way: {$START_TAG_STRONG}delete your account{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} from {$START_LINK}My account{$CLOSE_LINK}, which erases in one go your account, your sessions, your collection, your decks, your rewards and your games; your ongoing duels are then lost by forfeit, and your opponents keep their finished duels, without your username. For anything else, write to the project owner (see above): with no email or name, give the account ID shown in “My account”. If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL.
